name: Michigan State University Veterinary Medical Center Oncology
finding: The current MSU oncology index lists five named studies: CHOP versus LOPP, STING agonist, quasiorganelle therapy, neoadjuvant steroids for mast-cell tumor, and metastatic feline mammary therapy.
catalog_comparison: All five reconcile to exact canonical IDs; the dose-finding STING record remains outside public matching under the existing treatment-benefit scope, so no catalog change.
